evidence_trace_coupling.sharing: Same H/J across paired views and all methods; separate RNG keeps v1 latent inputs unchanged.
evidence_trace_coupling.interpretation: Assumed evidence dependence of score-correction features; not an estimated or trained method.

semantics.methods: Condition names only, not trained algorithms; no optimizer, search, tuning or ranking filter.
semantics.models: Model labels index assigned coefficients, not empirical estimates.
semantics.draws: All six conditions share latent evidence/nuisance/noise/labels and H/J within a model-task-seed.
semantics.direction: Count original-positive signed responses becoming nonpositive; rate denominator is original-positive responses. MedPIC uses changed option pairs, not case pairs. Zero eligible denominator is undefined.
semantics.placeholder: All generated values are provisional demonstration values, not predicted measurements. Replace from corresponding real paired scores before submission.
semantics.v1: Original positive-g-only pairing made sign degradation identically zero; archived in medical_extension_v1 and superseded, not evidence for protection.
semantics.multiselect: Independent yes/no score per option; predicted set is scores>0; exact set equality.
semantics.single_choice: argmax; one shared intercept for all options, hence calibration cannot change ranking.
semantics.MedPIC: 92 synthetic paired cases, option identities aligned; 1-2 labels change; unchanged labels are not nuisance interventions.
semantics.MedPAIR: Low deletion changes nuisance only by assumption. Key deletion attenuates evidence to 25%. Addback restores evidence/nuisance plus shared N(0,.08) context-order noise. Deletion/addback report margin changes, never post-deletion accuracy.
semantics.MedEinst: Shared nuisance favours control label in both sides; trap changes gold class. BTR=P(trap predicts control label | control correct).
semantics.TrialGPT: 1000 generated labels include 250 unknown; exclude unknown, retain included/not included and exclusion polarity as criterion satisfaction, not trial eligibility.
semantics.no_pairs: MedGUIDE/TrialGPT intervention metrics and every task path metric are undefined.
semantics.units: Real model score differences use logits; this generator uses synthetic score units. BTR is undefined with zero correct control predictions.
semantics.uncertainty: Mean and sample SD over five generation seeds only, not model training uncertainty or real confidence intervals. Undefined direction rates are omitted, defined seed count is recorded; SD needs at least two defined seeds.
